title: Invitation Mailing and RSVP Lag
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp mailed_epoch=*
| eval rsvp_lag_days=round((_time-mailed_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(rsvp_lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(rsvp_lag_days) as worst_lag_days by guest_group
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures how long different guest groups take to respond after invitations are sent.
value: RSVP lag shapes reminder timing and catering confidence, especially for complex guest mixes.
implementation: Track invitation mail dates and actual RSVP timestamps; summarize response lag by guest group.
visualization: Table of guest groups with average RSVP lag.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how long different groups of guests usually take to answer after invites go out.
